title: Train/Test Splits & Cross-Validation — Rotate the Practice Exam
key_insight: Cross-validation rotates several validation groups. Each row gets a turn outside training, and the scores reveal both average performance and wobble.
body:
## Rotate the Practice Exam

A small dataset gives a very different score depending on which rows are held out. One split is too lucky or unlucky.

Cross-validation rotates several validation groups. Each row gets a turn outside training, and the scores reveal both average performance and wobble.

Use validation folds to choose settings, then use the untouched test set once for the final report.
common_mistakes: Using the test set to choose model settings.
Randomly splitting time-ordered or grouped records.
Reporting only the best fold instead of the full variation.
mini_exercise: Draw the situation from “Rotate the Practice Exam” with three labeled steps, then explain what changes at each step.
real_world_usage: Without a fair split, every model comparison can be confidently wrong.
explain_back_prompt: Using the “Rotate the Practice Exam” story, explain Train/Test Splits & Cross-Validation without assuming the listener knows machine learning.

build_task.context: Turn the Train/Test Splits & Cross-Validation idea into one small, inspectable workflow.

Compare the single score with the fold average and spread.
